import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for event data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title}
{title}
Date: {date}
{description}
{notes}
""" def generate_event_invite(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generates a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The name or title of the event. description : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple lines). date : str The scheduled date for the event. notes : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML for safely displaying the event invitation. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required arguments are not strings. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (title, description, date, notes)): raise ValueError("All arguments must be strings.") # Escape user-provided content to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True) # Render the template with sanitized values return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, description=safe_description, date=safe_date, notes=safe_notes )
